images.filename: Getty Square Branch over McLean Avenue-2.jpg
images.caption: 1909-built walled-embankment along a hill that once supported the Getty Square Branch of the Putnam Division of the New York Central Railroad over McLean Avenue (former NY 164) in the Park Hill section of Southwest Yonkers, New York. Besides the wall along McLean Avenue the actual bridge support can be seen above and behind the rocks along the hill, which can't be seen in the previous picture.
images.alt: 1909-built walled-embankment along a hill that once supported the Getty Square Branch of the Putnam Division of the New York Central Railroad over McLean Avenue (former NY 164) in the Park Hill section of Southwest Yonkers, New York. Besides the wall along McLean Avenue the actual bridge support can be seen above and behind the rocks along the hill, which can't be seen in the previous picture.

images.filename: Getty Square Branch over McLean Avenue-1.jpg
images.caption: 1909-built walled-embankment along a hill that once supported the Getty Square Branch of the Putnam Division of the New York Central Railroad over McLean Avenue (former NY 164) in the Park Hill section of Southwest Yonkers, New York. The branch was abandoned in 1943, and the rest of the former New York and Putnam Railroad was abandoned gradually between 1958 and 1980.
images.alt: 1909-built walled-embankment along a hill that once supported the Getty Square Branch of the Putnam Division of the New York Central Railroad over McLean Avenue (former NY 164) in the Park Hill section of Southwest Yonkers, New York. The branch was abandoned in 1943, and the rest of the former New York and Putnam Railroad was abandoned gradually between 1958 and 1980.

images.filename: Our Benefits Went Up Billboard @ Getty Square Branch.jpg
images.caption: Billboard facing northwest-bound traffic along McLean Avenue (former NY 164) next to the embankment of the former Getty Square Branch of the Putnam Division of the New York Central Railroad in the Park Hill section of Southwest Yonkers, New York. The billboard is owned by Clear Channel, and the advertisement is for MVP Health Care claiming "Our Benefits Went Up; Our Premiums Went Down," with an apparent 50-something woman supposedly doing the twist.
images.alt: Billboard facing northwest-bound traffic along McLean Avenue (former NY 164) next to the embankment of the former Getty Square Branch of the Putnam Division of the New York Central Railroad in the Park Hill section of Southwest Yonkers, New York. The billboard is owned by Clear Channel, and the advertisement is for MVP Health Care claiming "Our Benefits Went Up; Our Premiums Went Down," with an apparent 50-something woman supposedly doing the twist.

images.filename: University Heights Metro-North Station; Old Put ROW.jpg
images.caption: The former right-of-way for the Putnam Division of the New York Central Railroad as seen from the center platform of the University Heights Metro-North railroad station on the Metro-North Hudson Line in the University Heights section of the Bronx, New York City. If this line still existed, there could easily be a second platform, pedestrian bridge and elevator between the Hudson and Putnam Lines. The bridge that the tracks and former tracks run under are for West Fordham Road between the University Heights Bridge and the interchange with the Major Deegan Expressway (Interstate 87 at Exit 9).
images.alt: The former right-of-way for the Putnam Division of the New York Central Railroad as seen from the center platform of the University Heights Metro-North railroad station on the Metro-North Hudson Line in the University Heights section of the Bronx, New York City. If this line still existed, there could easily be a second platform, pedestrian bridge and elevator between the Hudson and Putnam Lines. The bridge that the tracks and former tracks run under are for West Fordham Road between the University Heights Bridge and the interchange with the Major Deegan Expressway (Interstate 87 at Exit 9).
